title: Far memset/memcpy/memmove lengths above 65535 are truncated or deleted
summary: createFarMemLibcall truncates the length of an address-space-2 G_MEMSET, G_MEMCPY or G_MEMMOVE to 16 bits without a range check, and the IRTranslator has already truncated the length of a mixed-address-space memmove. A constant 70000-byte far memset calls __memset_far with 4464; a 65536-byte p2<-p0 memmove is deleted and the function returns at once; a runtime i32 memcpy length loses its high 16 bits. The compiler exits 0 and the verifier is clean. Found by the independent review (finding B2) and reproduced on the downstream toolchain.
attribution: Found by the independent reviewer of the rebased far-word series on the extracted candidate: Claude Code 2.1.283, model claude-opus-5-5 (Opus 5.5), high reasoning effort (t4-opus-high subagent of session f79adc39-72b4-4dc5-abc1-849c14c5ce96; verified from its transcript metadata).
Downstream reproduction, prior-work audit and this record: Claude Code 2.1.283, model Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), xhigh reasoning effort; session f79adc39-72b4-4dc5-abc1-849c14c5ce96.
unknowns: No repair attempted. The far runtime entry points take a 16-bit length; whether to split, reject or add 32-bit-length entries is undecided.
No emulator run: the wrong length is read from the emitted immediate operands.

prior_work.source_assessment: Downstream MOSLegalizerInfo.cpp createFarMemLibcall builds buildTrunc(LLT::scalar(16), Len) for any wider length (0002 and 0013 carry the same hunk); the extracted patch 4 matches.
prior_work.binary_assessment: Downstream release llc 9031686c emits ldx #112 / ldy #17 (4464) for the 70000-byte fill and a bare rts for the 65536-byte memmove; the extracted candidate d7fde754 emits the same.
prior_work.decision: mos-far-memset-wrong-bank fixed near/far runtime routing and explicitly excluded lengths above 65535 from its closure. This is the length-domain defect in the same function, a separate mechanism.

" "$out"; bad=0; if printf "%s
" "$out" | grep -A4 "^big_const:" | grep -q "ldy[[:space:]]*#17"; then echo "MISCOMPILE: 70000-byte far memset passes length 4464 (0x1170)"; bad=1; fi; if printf "%s
